catalog.role: Security Assurance levels for Zones and Conduits
catalog.description:
1. Addresses security risk assessment and system design for IACS
2. Establishes requirements for defining the zones and conduits of the system under consideration, assessing risk, establishing a target security level(SL-T), providing informal guidance on how to verify these requirements

catalog.role: System Security Requirements and Security Assurance levels
catalog.description: Describes the foundational system security requirements and security assurance levels

1. Describes the derived requirements that are applicable to the development of products. 
2. The product supplier will find process requirements which help him systematically address the security issues from specification phase throughout design, implementation, verification and validation and release until phase out. 
3. The purpose of this part is to improve the quality of product development process and to include security specific measures in the organizational as well in the technical area.

catalog.role: Technical Security Requirements for IACS Components
catalog.description:
1. Contains sets of derived requirements that provide a detailed mapping of the system requirements to subsystems and components of the system under consideration.
2. On the other side ISA 62443-3-3 and ISA 62443-4-2 specify security capabilities which should be fulfilled by the control system or components of the control system to support a defense in depth strategy when deploying an automation solution. 
3. A product supplier may choose to integrate a given set of functionalities depending on the security level expected in the target industries of the product. 
4. To achieve the required security level of the automation solution additional compensating countermeasures may be necessary.
